description: Small camp: a lean-to tent frame, a fire ring, a crate stack and a barrel. Reads as 'someone was here' rather than a building. 20x10px.
notes: Composite of detail props (crate/barrel/campfire, see the detail_* structures) pre-arranged into one scene so world.lua can place the whole vignette in one roll instead of coordinating four independent ones. Fire uses 'glow' (static, inert) rather than real FIRE -- a live flame in procedurally generated terrain risks igniting nearby WOOD/PLNT unpredictably; @items/@world should swap in real FIRE deliberately if they want it live.
